name: Russia–NATO
value: Estonia to shut Russia border from 1 Dec
summary: Estonia will close its Russian border crossings from 1 Dec over a sabotage plot it blames on Russia; no Article 4
state: Estonia said on 15 Nov it will close its border crossings with Russia from 1 Dec after an attempted arson at drone maker Threod Systems, which it blames on Russian military intelligence (Al Jazeera; UNN). On 11 Nov NATO jets were scrambled after at least four drones strayed into Baltic airspace during Ukrainian strikes on Russia, and two attempts to down one over Lithuania failed (Al-Monitor/Reuters). No Article 4 request or direct clash was found as of 21 Nov.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for the Baltic states and Russia's border regions.
rubric_hit: Sabotage attributed to Russia and airspace violations = Watch

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Estonia to close border crossings with Russia after attack on drone maker

why: Direct Russia–NATO confrontation is the most likely path to a European war involving the UK.
drivers: Airspace and drone incursions, sabotage, Baltic incidents, nuclear signalling, Ukraine war spillover.

rubric.alert: Article 4 consultations, a direct military clash, or an attack on NATO territory.
rubric.watch: Airspace/drone violations, sabotage attributed to Russia, or explicit threats against members.
rubric.normal: No notable incidents on NATO territory in the past two weeks.
